(actor nested_cond
  (interface (input request) (input allow) (input datain (width 3)) (input other (width 3)) (output seen (width 3)) (output done))
  (proc choose (params (c (width 1)) (d (width 1))) (cond (c (cond (d (set seen datain)) (else (set seen other)))) (else (set seen 0))))
  
  (transaction main (on request) (call choose allow request) (complete done)))
